description: This file defines a benchmarking class 'ArrayDeserializeBenchmark' that compares the performance of various serialization libraries (including Orleans, MessagePack, Protobuf, and System.Text.Json) for deserializing arrays of a custom type 'MyVector3'. It sets up static payloads for each serializer and provides benchmark methods for deserialization.

classes.name: ArrayDeserializeBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class that compares deserialization performance across multiple serialization libraries for arrays of MyVector3.

methods.name: MessagePackDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the payload using MessagePack serializer.

methods.name: ProtobufNetDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the payload using Protobuf serializer.

methods.name: SystemTextJsonDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the payload using System.Text.Json serializer.

methods.name: OrleansDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the payload using Orleans serializer.
